Animal Cafe · Inside the gym

Fuel before and after the work.

Protein shakes, açaí bowls, cold-pressed juice and coffee, made inside Animal Paradise. Open 4AM to midnight, the same hours you train.

On the menu

Built for people who train.

Most gym cafes are a fridge of drinks. Animal Cafe makes shakes, bowls and juice to order, so your post-workout meal is ready before you've wiped down the bench.

Cafe questions

Good to know

Where is Animal Cafe?

Animal Cafe is inside Animal Paradise Gyms at Cumberland Mall, 3849 S Delsea Dr, Suite E000, Vineland, NJ 08360.

What are Animal Cafe's hours?

The cafe keeps the same hours as the gym: every day from 4AM to 12AM.

What does Animal Cafe serve?

Protein shakes, smoothies, açaí bowls built to order, cold-pressed juices, wellness shots and coffee.

Do members get a discount at the cafe?

Yes. Gold members save 5%. Premium, Platinum and Diamond members save 10%.
